title: fix: align Laguna OpenRouter pricing
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Updates `laguna` provider cost from $0.10/$0.01/$0.20 to $0.09/$0.009/$0.18 per million uncached input/cached input/output tokens.
- Matches the exact pinned OpenRouter route `poolside/laguna-s-2.1` on Poolside (`poolside/fp4`), with provider fallback disabled.
- Verifies a direct pinned request and a full local Gen billing request; 38 uncached + 32 cached + 16 output tokens produced $0.000006588 and a $0.00000659 wallet debit after precision rounding.
- Leaves the canonical name, aliases, access, multiplier, routing, capabilities, and fallback unchanged.
- Passes 349 focused registry/pricing tests, both service typechecks, and Biome.

gist.headline: Laguna counts the tiny pollen
gist.blurb: Laguna’s token meter now matches its pinned Poolside route down to the millionth-dollar crumbs. The hive’s calculator has been given the right glasses.
gist.summary: Aligned the Laguna provider’s billing rates with the pinned OpenRouter route poolside/laguna-s-2.1 on poolside/fp4: $0.09/$0.009/$0.18 per million uncached input, cached input, and output tokens.
gist.impact: Laguna requests now receive wallet debits that match the pinned OpenRouter route, including precision-rounded billing such as a $0.00000659 debit for 38 uncached, 32 cached, and 16 output tokens.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli carefully calibrating a tiny retro token scale beside a cozy terminal labeled “Laguna,” with three small jars for uncached input, cached input, and output tokens marked 0.09, 0.009, and 0.18. A code-plant and soft flowers reinforce that accurate accounting helps the garden grow; Polli wears tiny round accountant glasses and looks pleased with the precisely balanced meter.
